$comment: Session boundary for the librarian (plan.md 6.2). What ENFORCES the boundary is the commit gate -- check 35 refuses a commit that crosses it, against the tree the commit would create. This file states the boundary; since 2026-09-19 it no longer claims to hold it.

permissions.$comment_deny_outside: THE TEN BELOW ARE INERT, AND KEPT ON PURPOSE. A path pattern resolves against the session root, and this session starts in librarian_agent/ -- so `Write(bridge/**)` means `librarian_agent/bridge/**`, which cannot exist. All ten name a sibling directory, contracts/ or plan.md, so none can ever match. Not deleted, because deleting them deletes the intent; labelled, because an unlabelled inert rule reads as protection to the next person, and that is the failure rather than the rule. What enforces this boundary is the commit gate and check 35. A tool denial WOULD work here -- tool names do not resolve against a root -- and this file contains none, so do not read this label as covering a kind of rule that is not here.
permissions.$comment_deny_inside: THE FOUR BELOW ARE LIVE. They resolve inside this root and they fire. The rule that picks them is ownership, not a list: anything inside this agent's own tree that ANOTHER seat owns. contracts/seats.json gives manager-librarian exactly these four -- CLAUDE.md, README.md, tasks/ and .claude/ -- and the executing seat owns kb/, queries/, src/ and failures.jsonl. This file claimed on 2026-09-19 that nothing could be aimed inward, reasoning from the absence of envelope/ and inbox/; that was a list where a rule was needed, and manager-simulation found the same error in its own file from the same relay. `tasks/` is the one that mattered: 6.2 rule 2 makes it the home of instructions that come DOWN, and until now the seat receiving them could edit them. A seat that can edit its own instructions has preferences, not instructions. `.claude/**` covers this file, which is correct and is why the manager writes it.

hooks.$comment: The validator's exit code is the only truth (plan.md 8). This read $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR until 2026-09-19, which is the session's own directory -- so from librarian_agent/ it looked for librarian_agent/contracts/validate.py, did not find it, and failed. A PostToolUse failure does not stop the write, so there was no symptom: every write from this seat went unvalidated at write time, and only the commit gate ever saw them. Same defect plan.md 7 records for .mcp.json, same fix: ask git where the repository root is instead of assuming the session is standing at it.
